This card is a [[Intel PRO/Wireless 2011b LAN 3A Mini PCI Adapter]] (M3AWEB) on a Mini PCI -> PCI adapter. :The same Mini PCI -> PCI adapter appears to be used for the [[Intel PRO/Wireless 5000 LAN PCI Adapter]].
